solutions_engineering.summary: Analyst who turns messy operational data into tools people actually use, then explains them in plain terms. At Kestrel Insurance Group, built a renewal-risk model on 640K policies and presented the outreach plan to regional leadership. Comfortable in customer-facing, fast-paced settings from years leading café shifts.

jobs.title: Analytics Intern
bullets: Built a claims-lapse model on 640K policy records that flagged 27% of at-risk renewals two months early, with 0.81 AUC.
Automated a weekly SQL + Python report that replaced a manual spreadsheet process for the retention team.
Presented findings and outreach recommendations to the regional operations leadership team.
Cleaned and joined claims, billing and call-center data from three source systems into one analysis table.

jobs.title: Graduate Research Assistant
bullets: Built a Python pipeline over 900K+ trip records to measure on-time performance by route and time of day.

Presented results to the lab and to the partner agency’s service-planning team.
